confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer estimates draw on [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Wellington). [Expatistan](https://www.expatistan.com/price/cocktail/wellington) has a small cocktail sample; cocktail and wine estimates also reflect their price relationship to beer, consistent with [Discover NZ](https://www.discovernewzealand.com/faqs/new-zealand-restaurant-meal-cost). Accommodation figures are holistic July estimates and vary with events and availability.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Wellington and comparable major New Zealand urban markets, adjusted for July winter conditions and Wellington's government and business demand.
